angles.lead_line: Scorpio season is here, and your energy is _yours_ to keep
angles.rationale: The intake's moment is Scorpio season and its audience is HLR's subscribers; the occasion frame ties the send to the calendar (route_axes axis_notes.occasion: zodiac seasons are an observed monthly ritual). The Classic Bracelet in Black Tourmaline leads, then the season block, then The Scorpio Crystal Set closes.

angles.lead_line: Black tourmaline, long held as a stone of _protection_
angles.rationale: Both lead pieces carry one stone, Black Tourmaline (intake.products[].facts.ingredients), so the product frame opens on the shared stone and says its meaning as tradition only (intake.guidance.notes; route_axes axis_notes.product). A text block opens before the two-up grid.

The intake's message ends on a reminder to keep your energy your own, which the benefit frame can lead with as intention rather than effect (intake.message; route_axes axis_notes.benefit, which waits on C2, so a person should read this angle with that caveat). A mantra opens, then the two bracelets.
